features: [Crystal Clear 1080P Evidence Day & Night] Catch critical details like faces, clothing, and vehicles with absolute clarity; the camera records in sharp 1080P Full HD video that plays back smoothly without skipping or lagging, ensuring you capture fast-moving objects clearly and never miss a vital moment on your property.

[Smart Dual-Light Color Vision in Pitch Darkness] Stop thief activity with vibrant, full-color night video; features 4 Array White LEDs that project up to 15 meters for All-Time Color Vision, alongside 4 Array IR LEDs providing stealthy stealth-monitoring up to 20 meters with an intelligent Auto ICR cut filter.

[Universal 4-in-1 Integration with Your Current DVR] Upgrade your property's protection without buying a brand-new recording system; this versatile camera supports TVI, AHD, CVI, and legacy CVBS analog formats using a heavy-duty standard BNC connector and UTC (Up-the-Coax) for simple configuration.

[Listen In with Advanced Coaxial Audio Surveillance] Protect your business or home with both eyes and ears; the integrated, high-sensitivity microphone captures crisp audio natively through the coax cable on TVI mode, giving you essential audio context during any incident

[Perfect Visibility in Blinding Lights or Dark Shadows] Maintain balanced, uncompromised image quality near windows or bright outdoor areas; integrated Digital Wide Dynamic Range (D-WDR) and 3D Digital Noise Reduction (DNR) actively clean up grainy footage and shadow distortion

[Weatherproof Durability with Lightning Protection] Rest easy through intense monsoon rains, dust storms, or extreme seasonal shifts; the rugged IP66-rated waterproof chassis is paired with heavy-duty 4000V lightning protection to shield your internal components from sudden power surges.

[Cut Hard Drive Storage Demands by Up to 50%] Record weeks of extra security footage without buying expensive additional storage; next-generation H.265 compression significantly shrinks file sizes and slashes bandwidth usage while preserving crisp video sharpness.
